rationale: Arpan and Kwaw both bring deep mobile engineering expertise (Swift, iOS, Android) and share a conviction that platform-first approaches beat building from scratch—Arpan through his fintech product engineering at Fintegration, Kwaw through his frustration with App Store constraints. Kwaw's passion for building tools that work and shipping publicly aligns with Arpan's belief that 'shipping publicly is the hardest but most valuable act for founders,' and Arpan's 14+ years in mobile development and fintech could offer strategic perspective on Kwaw's next product direction.
intro_message: Arpan Desai, meet Kwaw—you're both mobile-first builders with conviction about platform constraints, and Arpan's experience shipping fintech products at scale could help shape your next move.
